verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://decagon.ai/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a Decagon-specific summary, so an agent can be pointed at an llms.txt file. However, the visible content reads as a high-level platform description rather than in-depth technical docs, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to detailed developer/API documentation, an llms-full.txt or other agent-oriented doc set, a machine-readable API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its usefulness to agents.
